name: Sakurai Natsuki
source: One half of the popular sister idol duo, W. While she and her younger sister, [url=/c44308]Asahi[/url], both sing and dance, Natsuki is significantly better at it. Both are princesses who escaped from the Land of Light, and possess the ability to transform into magical girls. Natsuki's magical form is named Valkyrie Moon.
